Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this tournament. Netherlands and Zimbabwe have got what they wanted and now will look to sharpen their skills before the upcoming T20 World Cup. You can now switch tabs to catch all the updates from the third ODI between England and India in Manchester. Until next time, it's goodbye and cheers!

Craig Ervine, the captain of Zimbabwe, says that the crowd was outstanding this whole week and that shows the kind of cricket they have played. He thanks everyone for coming and supporting them. Adds that Sikandar Raza and Sean Williams' contributions have been valuable to them.

Scott Edwards, the Dutch skipper, says that this match didn't go well but it was a great tournament for them. Shares that it was a tough track to bat on, especially against the spinners. Admits that Zimbabwe played the conditions better than them.

Sikandar Raza is chosen for the Player of the Match award and he also bags the Player of the Tournament award for scoring 228 runs and picking 5 wickets. He says that more than winning the awards, he was worried about winning the tournament and wanted to win five out of the five games. Credits all the bowlers for a superb show in this match.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier, Zimbabwe's approach with the bat was not in sync with the situation. They kept losing wickets but still concentrated on scoring runs at a brisk rate. As a result, Zimbabwe ended up getting all out with three balls left unused. That didn't cost them though as their bowlers turned on the heat to defend the total with utmost ease in the end. Right then, Zimbabwe will now join Ireland, Scotland and West Indies in Group B for the First Round of the mega event while Netherlands will have Namibia, Sri Lanka and United Arab Emirates for company. To be honest, despite losing the final, the Dutch team won't be too disappointed to get that group.

The Netherlands were abysmal with the bat. The target was not significant, all they needed was to stitch in partnerships. However, they failed miserably in front of the Zimbabwean spinners. Stephan Myburgh was the only batter to put up a fight up front and then Teja Nidamanuru also tried his best towards the end, but the rest of the batting surrendered. The hosts used their spinners smartly and then brought in the pacers to pick the last couple of wickets.

A strong show with the ball from Zimbabwe to pocket the trophy! They didn't have a big score on the board, but Craig Ervine sized up the conditions and decided to unleash his spinners from the word go. Wesley Madhevere started things off with his tidy spell, and then the spin pair of Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza did the maximum damage. Sean dried up the runs from one end, and Raza benefited by hunting down four quick wickets.

OUT! LBW! All smiles in the Zimbabwe camp! Richard Ngarava fires in a yorker, tailing back in, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru walks across and tries to flick it on the leg side, but he misses and gets rapped on his pads. A huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger! Zimbabwe win by 37 runs!
Good running! A low full toss, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru smashes it aerially toward wide long off. The ball falls short of the fielder there. Two taken!
Outside off this time, a length ball. Teja Nidamanuru pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single. 40 needed off 12 balls.
Around middle and leg, on a length. Shariz Ahmad flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Wide! Down the leg side now, on a length. Shariz Ahmad misses his tuck and a wide is called!

Leg bye! A stifled appeal there for LBW, but the umpire says no! A fuller ball, around the leg pole. Teja Nidamanuru looks to flick this but he misses. The ball goes off his pads towards fine leg and the batters steal a leg bye!
Shorter ball, wide of off. Teja Nidamanuru cuts it uppishly in the vacant cover region. Two taken!
Shariz Ahmad is the number 11 batter for Netherlands.

OUT! TAKEN! Luke Jongwe strikes with his second delivery! He sends back Paul van Meekeren! Luke Jongwe misses his yorker and serves a low full toss on middle. Paul van Meekeren goes for the heave but the ball flies off the bottom half of his bat and towards wide long on. Milton Shumba takes an easy catch there. End is nigh for Netherlands!
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: Luke Jongwe begins with a length ball, width on offer. Teja Nidamanuru stays in his crease and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Luke Jongwe to bowl his first over.

SIX! Up and away! Second biggie of the over! Loopy one, full and around off. Paul van Meekeren tonks it towards long off. The fielder there hops to his right, but the ball goes over his head for a maximum. Netherlands need 47 more off 18 balls with 2 wickets in hand.
Fullish delivery, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru chips it uppishly towards long on for a single.
Shorter, outside off, it stays low as well. Teja Nidamanuru looks to cut this away but he misses.
SIX! KABOOM! Outside off, full again, a loopy ball. Teja Nidamanuru smokes it high over long off for a biggie!
Outside off, fuller one, loopy ball as well. Teja Nidamanuru initially goes for the scoop, but checks his shot later and leaves it alone.
Tosses it up, full around middle. Paul van Meekeren knocks it towards long on for a run.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Paul van Meekeren flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, short ball, spinning away. Paul van Meekeren cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Good stop! Sticks to bowling short, outside off. Paul van Meekeren hangs back and pushes it towards the bowler. Wellington Masakadza gets his left hand down and grabs the ball.
Back of a length, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru pulls it towards square leg for a run.
Flatter, short again, around off. Paul van Meekeren pushes it towards long off for another run.
Shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Teja Nidamanuru knocks it to long off for a single.
Wellington Masakadza is back on!
Tossed up, on middle, Teja Nidamanuru drills it down to long on for one.
Turn and bounce from outside off, Paul van Meekeren tries to defend but misses. The keeper also fails to gather the ball and they cross.
Fuller and on off, eased down to long off for a single.
Shortish and around off, Teja gets back to cut but mistimes it back towards the bowler.
Flatter and on leg, it's helped to square leg for a quick run.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, the batter offers no shot.
Fuller and on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Paul van Meekeren is the new man in. Also, Ryan Burl comes into the attack.

OUT! LBW! Raza has four and he has completely demolished the Dutch batting line-up. Quicker one, flatter and around off, Fred Klaassen chooses to stay back and work it on the leg side but misses. He is struck on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up. 4-1-8-4 - This is Sikandar Raza's incredible bowling effort.
Fred Klaassen comes to the crease.

OUT! TIMBER! Raza strikes again. The magic man for Zimbabwe is on fire. Slower through the air, full and around off, Tim Pringle shimmies down the track for a big shot downtown but fails to connect. It lands, spins back in and goes on to rattle the stumps. Raza roars. This match has fast slipped away from the Dutch.
Goes back inside the crease and tucks it with the spin to deep square leg. They cross.
Floated and full around middle, defended back.
Short and on off, Teja Nidamanuru pulls but finds short mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, Pringle hammers it down to long off for a run.
Too full and on middle, Tim digs it out to mid-wicket and picks up a run. Amazing spell from the Test captain of Zimbabwe, 4-0-10-1.
Stays back and pushes a full ball to covers.
Full and flighted outside off, Pringle tries to slog it over the leg side but misses.
A touch short and on middle, Tim goes back and flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Leans forward and pushes a full ball to covers.
Eases a full ball down to long on for a run.
Helps it off his pads to the leg side. Finds the gap and picks up a run.
Gets forward and pushes it through the line. Finds the fielder at covers.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Tim Pringle makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! SOUND OF TIMBER! Sikandar Raza is running in celebration. The crowd is going wild. Quicker one, full and around leg, Logan van Beek tries to sweep by going across the stumps but misses. The stumps are shattered and Zimbabwe are roaring.
Around middle, helped to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full, around off, Logan van Beek tries to reverse sweep but fails to connect cleanly.
The batter has just blocked that from his crease.
Logan van Beek is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Floated delivery, full and around off, Scott Edwards tries to unveil a conventional sweep shot but it takes the top edge. The ball flies to short fine leg where Richard Ngarava grabs a simple catch and celebrates with the crowd. The Dutch team is in massive trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Richard Ngarava b Sean Williams

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted and on off, Scott reverse-sweeps it towards covers and there is a hesitation over a run. In the end, no harm is done.
Shortish and on off, Teja goes back and helps it gently to mid-wicket for a quick run.
Turns it around the corner and picks up a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends.
Tosses it up, very full, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru pushes it back to the bowler. A wicket-maiden from Sikandar Raza! Netherlands are 54 for 4 at the halfway mark. They need 79 more off 60 balls!
Full and outside off. Teja Nidamanuru blocks it out towards cover.
Teja Nidamanuru gets on the front foot and pushes it to covers. Teja sets off for a run but is sent back. The fielder fumbles otherwise it would have been a run-out chance.
Fuller on off, pushed to covers.
Teja Nidamanuru is the new batter. 79  needed off 64 balls.

OUT! LBW! Another spinner grabs a wicket! This time its Sikandar Raza! Zimbabwe pick up a wicket at a crucial period. A flatter ball, quicker and fuller around middle and off. Stephan Myburgh gets down on his knee and goes for the sweep shot but he misses and gets hit on the pads. Sikandar Raza appeals in joy and the umpire, without any hesitation, raises his finger. Netherlands lose their fourth wicket.
Play and a miss! Flatter and close to off, spinning away, Stephan Myburgh tries to sweep but misses.
Outside off, a tad shorter. Stephan Myburgh pushes it towards covers for a single.
Another flatter delivery, around middle and leg. Stephan Myburgh once again rocks back and clips it to square leg.
Flatter one, around middle and leg. Stephan Myburgh flicks it towards square leg.
A sweep this time! Full around middle. Stephan Myburgh sweeps it towards the short fine leg fielder.
Around middle and off, fuller ball. Stephan Myburgh goes for the reverse sweep but hits it straight to the fielder at cover-point.
Fraction shorter, on middle. Scott Edwards hangs back and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, fullish delivery. Stephan Myburgh drives but finds the fielder at cover.
This one spins in, around middle. Scott Edwards covers the line of the ball and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, around middle and off, full as well. Scott Edwards reverse-sweeps this towards third man for a brace. 50 up!
Slower and full, around middle, it's clipped to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, punched through covers for a run.
Loopy and full, around off, Scott Edwards mistimes his reverse scoop to covers. They cross for a quick run.
Sikandar Raza to bowl now.
Tad shorter, on the pads again. Stephan Myburgh flicks but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
On the pads, fuller ball. Scott Edwards flicks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Bye! Outside off, fuller ball. Stephan Myburgh looks to drive this away but he misses. The keeper fails to grab the ball. A bye taken!
Skipper Scott Edwards walks in next. 88 needed off 81 balls.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bull's eye! Lovely from Milton Shumba! A fuller ball, turning in, around middle and leg. Stephan Myburgh tucks it towards backward square leg. He leaves his crease for a single, Tom Cooper also responds but he is sent back from midway. Milton Shumba, in the meantime, collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Tom Cooper dives but he fails to make his ground.
Outside off, shorter ball. Tom Cooper chips it in the vacant cover region for a single.
Sean Williams begins with a fuller ball, on the pads. Stephan Myburgh tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Sean Williams comes into the attack after the Powerplay.

Swing and a miss! Back of a length, wide of off. Tom Cooper rocks back and tries to slash this one but he misses this time. 6 runs off Richard Ngarava's first over! Netherlands are 43 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay!
Angling in on a length, around middle and leg. Tom Cooper tucks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! In the gap this time! Short and width on offer, angling away. Tom Cooper stays in his crease and cuts it past point for a boundary.
Good fielding! Fuller ball now, outside off. Stephan Myburgh drives it firmly through cover. Craig Ervine dives to his right and makes a good stop at the edge of the circle! Saves three runs.
A short one now, around middle and off. Tom Cooper looks to pull this but ends up dragging it through mid-wicket. Only a single.
Richard Ngarava begins with a length ball from over the wicket, around off. Tom Cooper stands tall and pushes it towards cover.
Richard Ngarava is introduced into the attack.
Flatter and fuller, on middle, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and on off, Myburgh goes back and forces it to long on for one.
Fires it flat and on middle, Stephan Myburgh keeps it out off the inner edge to square leg.
SIX! Fuller delivery, around off and in the slot for the batter, Stephan Myburgh goes aerial and dismisses it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Uses the angle of the bowler and tucks it in the gap at deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Shortish and around off, Myburgh punches it to the right of mid off.
Sliding down leg, Cooper attempts to sweep but again misses. 9 from the over.
Short and wide outside off, Tom tries to cut but misses.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Stephan punches it down to long on for a run.
SIX! This one has gone the distance. Loopy and full, around leg, Stephan Myburgh picks it up and muscles it over square leg for a biggie.
Quicker arm ball on middle, it's turned through square leg for a single.
Short in length and outside off, Cooper cuts but finds the diving point fielder. A good stop by Milton Shumba.
Wide! Sprays it way wide outside off, the batter leaves.
Full and outside off, Cooper strikes it down through mid on for a single. End of a fabulous over, 3 runs and two wickets off it.
Tom Cooper is the new batter in.

OUT! ANOTHER LBW! Zimbabwe have made a fantastic start. Wesley Madhevere gets one more delivery to land and skid off the surface. It pitches around off and hurries into the batter, Bas de Leede decides to play from the crease but fails to connect with his attempted flick shot. He is struck on the pads and the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. 116 needed off 103 balls.
Quicker through the air this time, around middle, Stephan Myburgh forces it down to long on for a run.
Slower through the air, full and around leg, Stephan flicks it to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery around off, Bas uses his feet to take it on on the full and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Bas de Leede walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! GIVEN LBW! Wesley strikes this time. Flatter delivery, full and around off, Max O'Dowd tries to hit it across the line by going down low but misses. It skids through and strikes him on the box and they appeal. The finger goes up and the crowd roars. Wesley Madhevere draws first blood.
Skidding down the leg side, Max O'Dowd fails to sweep and it goes off his pads. The ball rolls behind the keeper and they collect a leg bye.
Around middle, it's clipped through wide mid on for one.
Forces a full ball through mid off for a run.
FOUR! Full toss and outside off, Max O'Dowd goes down on one knee and this time connects with his sweep shot. He finds the gap at square leg and bags a boundary.
SIX! High and handsome! Floated one, full and outside off, Max O'Dowd goes aerial and dispatches it over wide long off for a maximum.
Flighted and outside off, Max O'Dowd tries to sweep but misses. He is hit on the pads, but the impact is outside off.
It will be spin from the other end as well! Wellington Masakadza comes into the attack.
Fullish and on middle, it's eased through mid-wicket for a single. Tidy start from Wesley Madhevere.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, O'Dowd tries to flick but misses. Netherlands are off the mark.
Short in length and wide outside off, Max O'Dowd tries to cut but misses.
Another delivery which is full and outside off, Max goes down and across to slog-sweep but misses. Stephan Myburgh walks up and has a word with his partner.
Swing and a miss! Flighted and full, outside off, Max O'Dowd goes down to sweep but misses.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it back.
Nearly a wicket on the first ball. A touch short in length, around off, Max tries to hit it across the line but misses. It goes very closely past the off pole.
